inspected.title: Instrumental Variables Regression with Weak Instruments

inspected.anchor: Printed p.16 / PDF p.18, exact Gaussian F statement and inversion discussion after Theorem 3; original scan visually inspected
inspected.supported: Weak-IV reduced-form null-test inversion can remain valid without a first-stage lower bound under the stated Gaussian exogeneity assumptions.
inspected.limit: New scalar quadratic formula and finite information-class invariance are project derivations; general PAG or dependent inference is not inherited.
